what_it_is: Fly-by-wire primary flight control actuators is listed in this atlas as a critical dependency. Transport-category FBW actuators are supplied by Moog (USA) and Liebherr (Germany). Indian industry has FBW actuator experience on Tejas (Godrej) but not at transport-category scale. Strategic gap with no committed Indian supplier; entry barriers are very high.
